units: canonical Blender metres; fixed rest-space coverage
limits: Conservative opening margins are provisional author controls, not measured garment clearance or an art pass.
Every vertex of a hidden polygon must satisfy its garment coverage predicate; crossing polygons stay visible.
Collar, wrist, waist and ankle skin overlap stays visible; no camera/frame/normal-ray visibility test is used.
A mask removes covered body polygons only. It supplies no garment surface and cannot repair a garment hole or silhouette.
Changing body positions, topology, skin fields or skeleton invalidates the frozen manifest. Author a fresh manifest on the exact new body.
Do not apply garment coverage unless that actual selected garment is equipped. Parent judges complete actual-PBR moving appearance.
